subarea: Minimum variable requirement on uploaded data
description: Open Sankey on uploaded data with no preselected fields and verify the warning state before the second variable is added.
primary_assertions: The two-variable warning is visible; the graph is absent before variable selection; the graph appears after the second field is added.
notes: This covers the highest-value Sankey gating behavior for real uploads.

subarea: Uploaded categorical field selection and third-layer rendering
description: Add three uploaded categorical variables in Sankey settings and verify the rendered graph updates coherently.
primary_assertions: Selected Sankey fields match the requested uploaded fields; axis-label count matches the selected field count; Sankey node and positive-link counts match the independently computed expectation.
notes: Covered with Profession, Node type, and WHO_class on the uploaded style fixture.

subarea: Uniform link color and font-size controls on uploaded data
description: Switch Sankey link coloring to Uniform and adjust node-label and axis-label font sizes on uploaded data.
primary_assertions: SelectedColorOption updates to Uniform; positive rendered links use the edited uniform color; node-label and axis-label font sizes update in the rendered SVG.
notes: This is the maintained Sankey visual-settings baseline.

subarea: Node tooltip on uploaded data
description: Trigger a Sankey node hover on uploaded data and verify the tooltip renders and hides correctly.
primary_assertions: The Sankey tooltip becomes visible for the hovered node, shows the active field label plus Count, and hides on mouseleave.
notes: This keeps a core Sankey SVG interaction under maintained coverage.

subarea: Sankey export to PNG
description: Export the uploaded Sankey view as a PNG file.
primary_assertions: The export dialog opens; writing a non-empty PNG file into cypress/downloads succeeds on the uploaded categorical Sankey fixture.
notes: This is the maintained Sankey export baseline.

subarea: Sankey export to SVG
description: Export the uploaded Sankey view as an SVG file.
primary_assertions: The export dialog writes a non-empty SVG file with stable filename handling into cypress/downloads.
notes: Covered alongside the PNG advanced export path and export-dialog state assertions.

subarea: Large uploaded Sankey smoke
description: Load a larger uploaded network, switch to Sankey, and confirm the Sankey view stays useful on a realistic large categorical combination.
primary_assertions: Sankey view opens on the large uploaded fixture; the explicit `subtype -> Diag month` selection produces deterministic node and positive-link counts; the render stays interactive instead of hanging or collapsing to zero-width output.
notes: Covered with a derived large node fixture that adds a maintained `Diag month` bucket so the large Sankey case uses a stable categorical axis instead of raw high-cardinality dates.

subarea: Direct file launch to Sankey from Files settings
file_types: distance edgelist; matrix; fasta; node + link; node with sequences; newick; sequence + epi link
fixtures: COVID_Dummy_distance_edgelist_snp.csv; AngularTesting_DistanceMatrix_TN93_BS.xlsx; SARSCoV2_Simulated_Sequences_snp.fas; TestStyleNodelist_snp.csv; TestStyleEdgelist_snp.csv; AngularTesting_nodelist_withseqs_TN93_BS.csv; AngularTesting_seqs_TN93_BS.nwk; AngularTesting_Epi_linklist_BS.csv
description: Set File Settings default view to Sankey before launch and confirm uploaded datasets reach an interactive Sankey without a manual view switch.
primary_assertions: The Processing Files flow finishes cleanly; Sankey mounts as the first interactive rendered view; selected Sankey fields still produce deterministic node and positive-link counts without requiring a post-launch view switch.
notes: Covered after exposing Sankey in File Settings and letting the Sankey component participate in the shared launch-render completion path.

subarea: Remove variables and return to warning state
description: Add multiple Sankey variables on uploaded data, remove one back to a 2-field graph, then remove again until only one field remains.
primary_assertions: SankeyFieldNames shrinks in order; the rendered graph recomputes when returning from 3 fields to 2; when only 1 field remains the graph clears and the two-variable warning returns.
notes: This now covers the remove-field regression path in the Variables table.

subarea: Reorder variables updates axis order and transition counts
description: Reorder uploaded Sankey variables in the settings table and verify the graph updates to the new left-to-right field order.
primary_assertions: SankeyFieldNames order changes to match the reordered table; axis labels update to the new order; node and positive-link counts recompute for the new adjacent field pairs.
notes: Covered by reordering a maintained 3-field uploaded Sankey and reasserting both the table order and rendered axis order.

subarea: Maximum five-variable guard
file_types: uploaded node + link with many categorical fields
description: Keep adding uploaded Sankey variables until the view reaches its configured limit and verify the add path stops cleanly at five fields.
primary_assertions: The fifth field is accepted; further adds are disabled; the warning state does not reappear; the rendered graph still updates correctly at the maximum field count.
notes: Covered with a maintained five-field uploaded Sankey selection resolved from the style fixture.

subarea: Source and Target link-color modes
description: Switch Sankey link coloring between Source and Target on uploaded data after configuring multiple fields.
primary_assertions: In Source mode each rendered link stroke matches the source-layer color; in Target mode each rendered link stroke matches the target-layer color; the uniform color picker is hidden outside Uniform mode.
notes: The maintained Sankey styling journey now exercises all three link-color branches.

subarea: Per-layer color edits update nodes and derived link colors
description: Edit one layer color in the Sankey Variables table and verify the affected Sankey column updates without recoloring unrelated layers.
primary_assertions: Only nodes in the targeted layer change fill color; unaffected layers keep their existing colors; Source or Target link colors update coherently when the edited layer participates in the chosen color mode.
notes: Covered by editing the middle Sankey layer color and reasserting both nodes and derived link strokes.

subarea: Link tooltip on uploaded data
description: Trigger a Sankey link hover on uploaded data and verify the link tooltip renders and hides correctly.
primary_assertions: The Sankey tooltip becomes visible for the hovered link, shows Source, Target, and Count, and hides on mouseleave while link opacity resets to baseline.
notes: Node and link tooltip behavior now share the maintained uploaded-data controls spec.

subarea: Node drag updates layout and link geometry
description: Drag a rendered Sankey node on uploaded data and verify the node position plus connected link paths update coherently.
primary_assertions: The dragged node changes vertical position; connected links update their path geometry during or after drag; drag end resolves collisions so layer nodes remain within bounds and non-overlapping.
notes: Covered against the maintained uploaded style fixture by asserting the moved node geometry and connected link path recompute plus same-layer collision resolution.

subarea: PNG advanced scale and resolution controls
description: Open Sankey PNG export, change the advanced scale, and verify the calculated resolution updates before export succeeds.
primary_assertions: The Advanced accordion is available for PNG; changing scale updates the displayed resolution text; the exported PNG remains non-empty after using a non-default scale.
notes: The maintained Sankey export journey now asserts the non-default scale path before writing the PNG.

subarea: Export dialog filetype toggle and cancel path
description: Toggle Sankey export between PNG and SVG and verify the export dialog hides or shows advanced controls correctly, then cancel without exporting.
primary_assertions: Advanced controls are hidden in SVG mode and available in PNG mode; Cancel closes the dialog without leaving it stuck open or mutating the selected filename unexpectedly.
notes: This now rounds out maintained Sankey export-dialog behavior coverage.

subarea: Cluster-based Sankey recomputes after filtering changes
description: Select cluster as one of the Sankey variables, then change filtering so cluster membership updates and verify the Sankey graph recomputes.
primary_assertions: When cluster is a selected Sankey field, changing threshold or another cluster-affecting filter updates SankeyFieldNames-dependent node/link counts instead of leaving stale cluster buckets rendered.
notes: Covered with the mixed-origin TN93 uploaded network by selecting cluster plus subtype, lowering the threshold to 0.01, and reasserting that cluster assignments plus Sankey expectations changed together.
